messages:
maya: spawning this thread to propose a 'rapid preflight probe'—a sub-5s intake gate that catches tokenizer/serialization + obvious decode-path mismatches and gives a compact actionable output.
ricardo: +1. want it cheap enough to run on CPU or tiny GPU slices. we shouldn't add significant cost to bulk onboarding.
zoe: list of checks i think are essential: token-count stability, detokenize roundtrip, canonical-seed deterministic sample, tiny perf smoke (p95), and a fingerprint match against registry.
ken: fingerprinting is key. propose a stable fingerprint string: "tokenizer_sha256|vocab_sha256|specials_v|quant_label". if exact match to an approved fingerprint we skip heavy checks.
fiona: important: quant_label must encode layout and bitwidth (e.g., q4_0, int8_ptq, fp16). quant variants change decode semantics.
maya: agree. also add a short adversarial probe set for unicode: emoji sequences, ZWJ clusters, non-BMP chars, combining marks, weird whitespace. run those first to fail fast.
ricardo: decoder canonicalization: temp=0, top_p=1, do_sample=false, max_new_tokens=24. freeze these for rapid probe so results are comparable across runs.
zoe: semantics for failures: hard-block if token-count mismatch for identical codepoints OR detokenize fails. advisory if det_confidence below threshold or small behavior_delta. advisory should generate a triage ticket with diffs.
ken: UX: Console should show preflight badge: preflight:pass | preflight:advisory | preflight:block. badge tooltip must explain action (auto-block for hard, manual triage for advisory).
fiona: security: customer golden traces only opt-in. store salted hashes (sha256) and salt in KMS. never store raw customer text.
sre-bot: rapid_preflight queued for model redwood/atlas-mini at 5120007790.
sre-bot: rapid_preflight finished for redwood/atlas-mini: status=advisory, token_count_ok=true, roundtrip_ok=true, det_confidence=0.89, perf_p95=16ms, golden_hash=not_provided.
maya: sounds like det_confidence flaked. ricardo please add a runner metric for 'preflight-flake-rate' and track trends.
ricardo: will add metrics and set default runner concurrency to 6, timeout 3.5s. also rate-limit per-intake to avoid spike loads.
zoe: manifest snippet for docs: ```preflight_probe: enabled: true samples: 12 seq_len: 32 seed: 2025 timeout_ms: 3500 fingerprint: "tokenizer_sha256|vocab_sha256|specials_v|quant_label"```
ken: migration: write a tool to compute fingerprint for existing registry rows so we can short-circuit older variants once fingerprints are known-good.
fiona: for multimodal checklists: image-tokenizers or patch-token encoders need separate roundtrip logic. add plugin hooks for non-text modalities.
maya: good flag. include 'plugin_check' hooks in manifest so teams can opt into modality-specific micro-tests.
ricardo: followups: 1) RFC patch with acceptance matrix (pass/advisory/block), 2) runner impl for canonical decode + concurrency defaults, 3) Console badge + re-run button, 4) migration tool for fingerprints, 5) security flow for golden hashes. timeline: alpha opt-in in 2 sprints.
zoe: i'll draft the RFC + example CLI commands for rerun: `redwood onboard preflight run <model> --seed 2025 --samples 12`.
ken: i'll prototype fingerprinting tool and add quant_label parsing to model-manifest.
fiona: i'll coordinate with security on KMS salt storage and with docs on soft-fail wording so support doesn't panic.
maya: thanks all. i'll post the RFC link when it's ready and tag reviewers.
